entities.summary: Martin Kollár is a Slovak photographer and cinematographer. He was awarded the Leica Oskar Barnack Award in 2014. Kollár has had solo exhibitions at the Maison européenne de la photographie, Paris; Le Château d'eau, Toulouse; Reiss Engelhorn Museum, Mannheim; Slovak National Gallery, Bratislava; Benaki Museum, Athens; and Musée de l'Élysée, Lausanne.
